info.name: Invoice.CqrsAPI
info.description:
Walkthrough for the CQRS API. Run the collection in the Collection Runner from top to bottom: it creates its own data (unique per run), chains the ids, and finishes with the expected errors.

Set the baseUrl variable if you do not use http://localhost:5064.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set("run", Date.now().toString());  // new unique suffix for every run

request.description: Also creates a fresh {{run}} suffix, so codes / user names are unique on every run.
User/Create is anonymous, exactly like Invoice.CoreAPI. Password must be 8+ characters.
Stores the token in {{token}}. Every other request sends it automatically (collection-level Bearer auth).

item.name: PO line now shows received quantity
Create a 2nd invoice for MORE than the stock (qty 500)
Post it -> rejected: not enough stock

request.description: The BAL checks stock when posting. The invoice stays Draft.

item.name: 6. Errors and business rules (each one is EXPECTED to fail)
Validation: blank code and name -> 400 with the list of failures

exec: pm.test("lists Code and Name", () => { const props = j.data.map(f => f.property); pm.expect(props).to.include.members(["Code", "Name"]); });

request.description: Code CAT-{{run}} already exists (created in folder 1).
